author: Connor Creates
description:
if you have backyard dandelions you’ve got the potential to make some delicious homemade wine!

Here’s the full list of ingredients:
- 1 quart yellow dandelion blossoms
- 1 gallon boiling water
- 8 cups white sugar
- 1 orange sliced
- 1 lemon sliced
- 1 (.18 ounce) package wine yeast

This was a really fun project to try! Go check out the full video to see how I turned it into a premium wine brand! #dandelions #foraging #homemade #diy #homemadewine #wine
title: I Turned Dandelions into Wine
